decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: baseline includes “saving, editing”; round 1 client says much of it matches and does not contest those capabilities.
decisions.note: The recorded save/edit decision is compatible with the reference; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker includes “search”; round 1 client: “Plain text search is good.”
decisions.note: The presented plain-text search capability itself conforms; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker includes “tags”; the client requests enhancements but does not reject tag assignment.
decisions.note: Basic tag assignment is a conforming recorded decision; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker separately includes “archiving, and deletion”; round 1 client accepts those concepts while asking for bulk use.
decisions.note: Presenting archive and deletion as separate operations aligns with the reference; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 client reports the presented spec put “automatic metadata retrieval” out of scope and supplies the expected title, description, icon, and preview-image behavior; round 2 maker confirms these are “now” core.
decisions.note: The client replaced the exclusion with the reference-conforming metadata behavior; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 client: “I don't see that anywhere” and requests marking links unread, viewing an unread-only list, and marking them read; round 2 maker adds “Read-later/unread tracking.”
decisions.note: The client requested the missing read-later lifecycle; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 client says the baseline is “one-at-a-time” and asks to “select a bunch of bookmarks” for shared actions; round 2 maker adds individual selection bulk actions.
decisions.note: The client requested the missing multi-selection behavior; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 client requests “apply to everything currently showing” after filtering; round 2 maker adds “all current results” bulk actions.
decisions.note: The client requested the missing current-filter-wide action; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 client asks to search “by a tag specifically,” using a marker; round 2 maker adds combined text and `#tag` searches.
decisions.note: The client requested the missing tag-query syntax; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 client asks to combine terms as “this tag and that word, or one tag or another”; round 2 maker adds AND/OR behavior.
decisions.note: The client surfaced the missing AND/OR portion of the reference search language; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 baseline presents ordinary search; the round 1 client requests AND/OR but does not mention NOT. Round 3 maker later calls NOT part of the “remaining search behavior.”
decisions.note: The initial search decision also lacked NOT, but that difference was not expressed in the round 1 response; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 baseline presents ordinary search; the round 1 response does not request parenthesized grouping. Round 3 maker later calls parentheses part of the “remaining search behavior.”
decisions.note: Grouping remained an unexpressed difference in the first specification review; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 baseline presents ordinary search; the round 1 response does not mention quoted exact phrases. Round 3 maker later identifies exact phrases as remaining behavior.
decisions.note: Exact-phrase matching was absent but not surfaced in the first response; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 client asks that tag entry “suggest tags I've already used”; round 2 maker adds “Reusable tag suggestions.”
decisions.note: The client requested the missing existing-tag autocomplete; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 client asks to save “a search plus some tags” for reuse; round 2 maker adds saved searches containing query and filters.
decisions.note: The client requested the missing reusable saved-filter capability; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 client asks the app to retain a page snapshot so changed or disappeared content remains viewable; round 2 maker adds page snapshots.
decisions.note: The client requested the missing snapshot capability; this decision concerns presence of snapshots, not the later divergent storage format.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 client requests sorting “different ways (not just newest first)”; round 2 maker adds multiple sorting options.
decisions.note: The client requested the missing selectable sort behavior; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 client asks for “a place to adjust basic display preferences”; round 2 maker adds theme and information-density preferences.
decisions.note: The client requested the missing display settings; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker explicitly says “import/export are excluded from the first release”; round 1 client enumerates exclusions that may remain but does not mention or correct import.
decisions.note: Netscape HTML import was explicitly excluded and passed without an expressed correction; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker explicitly says “import/export are excluded from the first release”; round 1 client enumerates exclusions that may remain but does not mention or correct export.
decisions.note: Netscape HTML export was explicitly excluded and passed without an expressed correction; specification gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents automatic title, description, icon, and preview-image retrieval plus editable metadata; round 2 client says “the page-details ... read right.”
decisions.note: The revised metadata decision conforms; revised specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents dated page snapshots with retry, refresh, and failure states; round 2 client says the snapshot behavior reads right and accepts retaining one current snapshot.
decisions.note: The generic snapshot and retention decision is compatible with the reference; the later explicit WebP format is assessed separately.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents “Read-later/unread tracking”; round 2 client says read-later “read[s] right.”
decisions.note: The revised read-later decision conforms; revised specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents combined text and `#tag` searches; round 2 client accepts that part of searching.
decisions.note: Tag-query syntax conforms; revised specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents AND/OR behavior; round 2 client says “this and that” and “this or that” are great.
decisions.note: The presented AND/OR portion conforms, while separate omitted search behaviors are classified below.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents search with AND/OR only; round 2 client requests excluding a word or tag. Round 3 maker adds `NOT` exclusions.
decisions.note: The client requested the missing NOT behavior; revised specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker's search summary omits phrases; round 2 client requests quoted exact wording. Round 3 maker adds double-quoted exact phrases.
decisions.note: The client requested the missing exact-phrase behavior; revised specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents AND/OR without grouping; round 2 client asks for grouping so the app knows “what goes with what.” Round 3 maker adds parentheses.
decisions.note: The client requested the missing parenthesized grouping; revised specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents reusable tag suggestions; round 2 client says everything outside the identified search gaps matches intended use.
decisions.note: Existing-tag suggestions conform; revised specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents saved searches containing query, filters, and sorting; round 2 client says saved searches read right.
decisions.note: The reusable saved-filter decision conforms; revised specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents individual selection bulk actions; round 2 client says bulk actions read right.
decisions.note: Multi-selection bulk actions conform; revised specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents “all current results” bulk actions; round 2 client says bulk actions read right.
decisions.note: Filter-wide bulk action scope conforms; revised specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents multiple sorting options; round 2 client says sorting reads right.
decisions.note: Sorting conforms; revised specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents theme and information-density preferences; round 2 client says the display parts read right.
decisions.note: These are qualifying display-related personal settings; revised specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 3 maker presents NOT exclusions and parentheses with defined precedence; round 3 client says leaving things out and grouping are “exactly what I was after.”
decisions.note: The revised Boolean and grouping decision conforms; final specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 3 maker presents double-quoted exact phrases; round 3 client explicitly confirms exact-phrase behavior.
decisions.note: Exact-phrase matching conforms; final specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 3 maker says saved searches retain the complete expression; round 3 client approves the baseline including saved searches.
decisions.note: Retaining the complete search expression in a saved filter conforms; final specification review.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker explicitly selects “Full-page WebP snapshots”; the reference requires local single-file HTML and stored PDFs for PDF URLs. Round 4 client says the technical choices are over their head and generally trusts them, without identifying this format difference.
decisions.note: The snapshot representation contradicts the reference. The response is not accepted_divergence because it never states the HTML/PDF expectation or the difference; planning gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker's first milestone includes reopening “the live page”; round 5 client explicitly approves reopening the live page or saved copy.
decisions.note: Providing access to the original URL conforms; task-planning gate.

decisions.evidence: Round 6 maker presents URL-only saving with asynchronous metadata retrieval; round 6 client reports testing address-only saving and automatic title retrieval.
decisions.note: The implemented save-and-enrich decision conforms; implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Round 6 maker presents implemented “Safe full-page snapshots,” carrying forward round 4's explicit WebP decision; round 6 client confirms a saved copy opens but does not identify the required HTML/PDF format difference.
decisions.note: The divergent WebP snapshot decision is presented again at implementation review. Generic approval of a saved copy is not explicit acceptance of the format departure.

decisions.evidence: Round 6 maker lists editing and tags as implemented; round 6 client says the app matches the agreed saving and organization behavior.
decisions.note: The recorded editing and tagging implementation decision conforms; implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Round 6 maker lists read-later as implemented; round 6 client reports that the read-later list shows the correct item.
decisions.note: The implemented read-later behavior conforms; implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Round 6 maker separately lists archive, restore, and deletion as implemented; the client accepts the organizational behavior.
decisions.note: Reversible archive and distinct deletion conform; implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Round 6 maker presents phrases, tags, NOT, AND, OR, and parentheses; round 6 client reports testing exclusions, quoted phrases, and combinations successfully.
decisions.note: The implemented advanced-search decision conforms; implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Round 6 maker lists saved searches as implemented; round 6 client says saved views match the agreement.
decisions.note: Saved searches conform; implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Round 6 maker presents explicit-selection bulk actions; round 6 client accepts bulk tidying behavior.
decisions.note: Explicit multi-selection bulk actions conform; implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Round 6 maker presents all-results bulk actions with count confirmation; round 6 client accepts bulk tidying behavior.
decisions.note: Whole-current-result bulk actions conform; implementation review.

decisions.evidence: Round 6 maker lists sorting, display settings, and responsive theme choices; round 6 client says sorting and display options match the agreement.
decisions.note: The implemented sorting and personal display settings conform; implementation review.

decisions.evidence: The round 6 runnable application is the maker presentation; the client reports that re-saving the same link warned it was already saved and pointed to the existing item instead of creating a duplicate.
decisions.note: The duplicate-save behavior observed during implementation review conforms to the reference.
